answer: A farm holding a stock of pre-written paragraphs hence has to rewrite every one of them each epoch, so the saving from bulk authoring disappears and the operator pays authoring per alias. Because the nebula hash is checked against the basalt checkpoint at intake, the hollow audit keeps the value, and a stale hash burns the key its whole submission. Each duplicate costs another 181 dollars in locked collateral and another 3 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
